added: Interactive word search with server-side prefix autocomplete across a graph database of 3.7+ million words, plus a randomized bank of suggestions.
Etymology tree visualization rendered as a directed acyclic graph, with clickable nodes and labeled relationships.
Hierarchical language-family chart with a proportional legend.
Geolinguistic map showing shaded language regions (GeoJSON for 5,000+ languages) and a region-shaped heatmap based on temporal and spatial diffusion.
Prose etymology narrative for each word.
Interactive blog posts about various linguistics topics.
Responsive layout with a draggable split between the map and content panel, adapting from desktop to mobile.
Language-specific results via the ?lang= query parameter.
Accessibility: ARIA semantics and full keyboard navigation.
Server-side caching with Redis, plus client-side request caching.
Linting and formatting with a pre-commit hook.
Continuous integration running build, tests, lint, and format checks.
